card.name: Punctuation before poison-control instructions
card.fires_on: The comma after "In case of accidental overdose" in child-safety warnings. Also fires on a dash in a time range in a poison-center phone line, and on punctuation just before a pointer to further information.

modes.label: Overdose warning comma
modes.description: The comma after "In case of accidental overdose", just before the instruction to call a doctor or poison control.
modes.example: In case of accidental overdose<<,>> call a doctor or poison control center immediately

modes.label: Poison center hours
modes.description: The dash in a time range in a poison-center phone listing.
modes.example: please call NPIC at 1-800-858-7378 (7:30am<<->>3:30pm PST), or

modes.label: Pointer or regulatory sentence end
modes.description: A word or period that ends a statement and leads into a pointer to more information or a program description.
modes.example: does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.<< See>> additional information.

card.writes: It suppresses "warning" words, so the text goes on to the instruction rather than another warning label.
card.plain: It fires at the point in a safety notice where the text turns to what to do, such as call poison control.
